description: The settings.set happy path (S44 T5): a value that parses under the key's type and bounds writes the row and reports changed=true with the new SettingView. The audit actor is the CONNECTION's (the daemon's ActorFor, "user:1000"), never a params field — a caller cannot forge the identity of a write to its own rules (CS8). set is the only door that changes a value; the event it records (CS12) is what a client that lists later sees. A value that fails the type/bounds refuses with settings.set's invalid-value code before any write.
